summary: Indie motorcycle combat racer positioned as a spiritual successor to Road Rash.

entries.title: Road Redemption

emulation.notes: No emulation needed for the recommended route.

primary.why: Road Redemption released first on Windows, macOS, and Linux in 2017, then on PlayStation 4, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, Android, and iOS. Windows has the highest output ceiling and earliest full release path.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release; use console or mobile versions only for platform preference.

entries.remaster_caveats: Spiritual successor to Road Rash, not an official Road Rash entry.
